quiAime.modesDesc: The twenty questions are the same. On your own, you see which way the scale tips in your eyes. Together, you each answer separately and find out whether you see your relationship the same way.
quiAime.modeSoloDesc: You answer for both of you, based on what you see day to day.
quiAime.modeDuoDesc: Take turns on the same phone, without seeing each other's answers.
quiAime.setupDescSolo: Twenty questions about the little things you do every day: the first text, the apologies, the surprises... For each one, say who does it more often: you, your partner, or both of you equally.
quiAime.setupTitreDuo: Which of you loves the other more?
quiAime.setupDescDuo: Enter your names. The first person answers all twenty questions, hands over the phone, and the second answers in turn. The result shows which way the scale tips, and whether you see it the same way.
quiAime.avertissement: There's no right answer: go with what really happens between you, not with what would please the other.
quiAime.relaisDebut: Answer without letting the other see the screen.
quiAime.relaisSuite: {{nom}} is done. Hand over the phone: their answers stay hidden until the result.
quiAime.balanceLegende: Each person's share in your answers
quiAime.r_egal_d: Your answers are split almost evenly: you each give in your own way, and the other one sees it. Research on the subject says the same thing: couples where both put in as much are happier and last longer.
quiAime.r_egal_d_solo: In your eyes, the scale is almost perfectly balanced: you each give in your own way. Now, does {{autre}} see it the same way? Take the quiz together to find out!
quiAime.r_unPeu_d: The scale tips slightly toward {{nom}}: {{nom}} is more often the one who sends the first text, suggests going out or makes the first move after a fight. That's the case for lots of couples, and it doesn't mean {{autre}} loves less: we don't all show love the same way.
quiAime.r_unPeu_d_solo: In your eyes, the scale tips slightly toward {{nom}}: {{nom}} is more often the one who thinks of the little things. That doesn't mean you love less: maybe you show it in other ways, through things this quiz doesn't ask about.
quiAime.r_unPeu_d_vous: Going by your answers, you're slightly more often the one who makes the first move, sends the first text or plans the surprises. That doesn't mean {{autre}} loves you less: some people show love through things you don't always notice.
quiAime.r_plus_d: The scale clearly tips toward {{nom}}: for most of the little gestures, {{nom}} is the one doing them. It can be a matter of personality, or a period when {{autre}} has less room for the relationship. The most useful thing is to talk about it simply, without keeping score: what makes each of you feel loved?
quiAime.r_plus_d_solo: In your eyes, {{nom}} is clearly more often the one doing the little everyday gestures. Maybe you show your love in other ways. The simplest thing is to ask {{nom}} which gestures matter most, and to talk about it together!
quiAime.r_plus_t_vous: You're the one who loves more
quiAime.r_plus_d_vous: Going by your answers, you're mostly the one doing the little things: the first text, the apologies, the surprises. If it weighs on you, tell {{autre}} without blaming: we don't always see what the other does for us. And if it suits you, that's simply your way of loving.
quiAime.accordTitre: Do you see your relationship the same way?
quiAime.accordTexte: You agree on {{n}} questions out of {{total}}.
quiAime.accordHaut: You see your relationship the same way, that's a good sign!
quiAime.accordMoyen: On the rest, you each mostly see what you do yourself. That's very common: we remember our own efforts better than the other person's.
quiAime.accordBas: You see your relationship quite differently. The questions where you disagree are good things to talk about, without trying to decide who's right.
quiAime.chacunMoiTitre: You each think you do more
quiAime.chacunMoiNote: On these questions, you both answered “Me”.
quiAime.chacunAutreTitre: You each think the other does more
quiAime.chacunAutreNote: Here, you each gave the point to the other. That's pretty sweet!
quiAime.soloAutreTitre: Where {{autre}} does more, in your eyes
quiAime.soloVousTitre: Where you think you do more
quiAime.invitationDuo: It's even more telling together: you each answer separately, and you'll see whether {{autre}} sees things the way you do.
quiAime.toutTitre: All your answers, side by side
quiAime.q1: Who sends the first text of the day?
quiAime.q2: Who says “I love you” more often?
quiAime.q3: Who remembers to bring home that little thing the other loves?
quiAime.q4: Who remembers the little details the other mentioned?
quiAime.q5: Who asks how the other's day went, and really listens to the answer?
quiAime.q6: Who gives more hugs and kisses for no reason?
quiAime.q7: Who makes the first move to make up after a fight?
quiAime.q8: Who more often suggests doing something together?
quiAime.q9: Who plans the surprises and the birthdays?
quiAime.q10: Who talks about the other to friends, even when the other isn't around?
quiAime.q11: Who finds it harder to be away from the other for a few days?
quiAime.q12: Who makes more compromises, about nights out, trips or family?
quiAime.q13: Who takes care of the other when things aren't going well, a cold or a bad week?
quiAime.q15: Who keeps the little notes, the movie tickets and the keepsakes?
quiAime.q17: Who talks more often about the future together?
quiAime.q18: Who would find it hardest to live without the other?
quiAime.q19: Who would move to a new city or change jobs for the other?
quiAime.q20: Who sneaks looks at the other, just for the pleasure of it?
